mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the head-turn example shows how the pieces help steady vision and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two kinds of balance organ and adding their nerves felt repetitive; the results mainly confirmed the assembly without explaining much more.

surprise.text: I was interested that weighted membranes respond both to head tilt and to changes in straight-line motion; the comparison helped distinguish their role from the turning sensors.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the separate assembly steps were predictable and offered few meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered another concrete example like the head-turn reflex. The explanations were useful, though several intermediate combinations felt routine.
